rationale: C20 is the only displayed directive using the same specialized presidential-Civil Aeronautics Board machinery: presidential action concerning airline route certificates, followed by instructions to the Board to record or implement that action. The child adapts that framework to a different route and remedy by requesting a revised Board order temporarily certifying two carriers. C11 shares the policy tension between supporting private transportation enterprise and preventing excessive federal subsidy, but it concerns maritime contracting and uses different machinery. C23 shares a reasoned presidential reversal followed by a direction to an agency, but its subject and administrative mechanism are substantially less similar.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I request the Board present for my approval a revised order in this case which would certify both Northwest Airlines and Pan American World Airways
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I direct the Civil Aeronautics Board ... to take all steps necessary and appropriate to accomplish ... the pattern of air transportation contemplated
shared_material.explanation: Both use a presidential letter to the Civil Aeronautics Board to direct certificate-related action implementing the President's chosen air-service arrangement.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Renewing the certificates of both carriers for a limited period would afford them an equal opportunity
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I withdraw my approval of the three certificates for air service to Mexico issued to Eastern Air Lines, Braniff Airways, and Western Air Lines
shared_material.explanation: Both center on presidential disposition of operating certificates held by named airlines, adapting the same concrete administrative framework to different routes and outcomes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Accordingly, I request the Board present for my approval a revised order in this case
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Will you please officially record the action that I have taken withdrawing my approval, and notify the airlines
shared_material.explanation: Each closes by instructing the Board to formalize the presidential decision and carry it into administrative effect.
